title: Delete the exact Progress-217 product history and strategies
author: agent:/root

originalRequests.text: Разрешаю. И уменьши порции для удаления
Мы делаем так, чтобы это работало. Ты сам определи, сколько надо удалять строк и выполнять транзакций
Не нужно этого делать, я это делаю в другом чате
Я не понимаю смысла этих действий и смысла вопроса. Мне просто нужно удалить историю по неработающим стратегиям и сами эти стратегии.

scope.goal: Delete exactly the already selected 217 stopped unreferenced negative-Progress strategies and their exactly attributable structured product history. Normal concurrent updates to retained strategies do not block this cleanup.
inScope: Use without recalculation the immutable 217 UUID/code target set approved by RC-20260819-remove-217-unreferenced-negative-progress-strategies at sha256:f5f2af6d514277bfeacdc14c70e6efdcceb50173a240aeb538160149791ff0ac.
Before deletion, verify that all 217 exact targets still exist, are stopped, have no active Live orders and have no active strategy references.

Delete only structured product history exactly attributable to the 217 targets through their strategy IDs, codes, trader wallets, orders, fills, runs, positions, settlements, signals, ended child assignments, skip tombstones and rollups, Progress state, and Dashboard projections.
Delete the exact 217 strategy rows only after their guarded dependencies reach zero, then insert the existing cleanup marker once.
Preserve every non-target strategy, including the six retained strategies, by exact ID, code and reference checks. Their volatile counters, balances and timestamps may continue to update normally.

Choose short independently committed batches from current production evidence, starting at no more than 10000 physical rows per relation and downshifting to 5000, 2500 or 1000 when a completed batch exceeds 5 seconds. Never increase the limit automatically.

Before each next batch verify Running/Live service state, an advancing heartbeat no more than 60 seconds old, empty last_error, zero ungranted locks, unchanged exact target identity guards, and reconciliation of the previous batch.
Use remaining exact target-owned rows as the durable resume point so interrupted cleanup can safely continue.
Keep the local database read-only while it contains zero exact targets.
Run focused existing tests plus exact read-only prechecks and postchecks.
outOfScope: Deleting or modifying any non-target strategy or its history as part of this cleanup.
Freezing or comparing volatile counters, balances or updated_at fields on retained strategies.
Any index, PostgreSQL schema, migration, immutable baseline, checksum, index test, rebuild or deployment work; the user is doing that in another chat.
Stopping or restarting the service, cancelling orders, changing Live/Paper mode, or pausing unrelated strategies.
Creating a backup, dump, archive, database clone, permanent cleanup framework, trigger, batching table or reusable deletion service.
Disabling triggers, VACUUM FULL, pg_repack, REINDEX, physical database shrink or compact-v2 activation.
Deleting shared or global rows without an exact target owner, shared compact-v2 dimension rows, or unstructured global logs.
Any unrelated trading logic, strategy behavior, source code, documentation or database change.
scope.periodOrFilter: The exact fixed 217 UUID/code product target set already approved for Progress-217 removal; no time-window expansion and no additional strategies.
scope.firstVerification: Run a fresh read-only product preview of the exact 217 IDs with stopped-state, active-order, active-reference, dependency-count, service-health and lock checks before the first DELETE.

requirements.text: Delete all structured product history exactly attributable to the exact 217 selected stopped strategies, using short independently committed production-safe batches.

acceptanceCriteria: A fresh read-only preview finds exactly the fixed 217 UUID/code targets, all stopped, with zero active Live orders, zero active strategy references and no identity collisions.
Every deletion transaction contains only exact target-owned rows, affects no more than its current evidence-sized relation limit, commits independently and records affected and remaining counts.
No next batch begins unless service health, lock state, target identity and previous-batch reconciliation checks pass.
After cleanup, every guarded structured relation contains zero rows attributable to the exact 217 targets.
Normal updates to volatile fields on retained strategies do not block cleanup and are not treated as cleanup changes.
